reference.en: Most of the time, a cache is the reason a fast system feels so fast to the people using it.
reference.fr: La plupart du temps, si un système nous semble rapide, c'est grâce à une mémoire cache bien pensée.

en: The first thing you notice about the old library is the quiet.
Not silence, exactly, but a kind of patience, as if the books were waiting for someone to ask the right question.
fr: La première chose qu'on remarque dans la vieille bibliothèque, c'est le calme.
Pas vraiment le silence, plutôt une sorte de patience, comme si les livres attendaient qu'on leur pose la bonne question.
Presque chaque jour, quelqu'un le fait.

voices.name: London storyteller
voices.summary: Older Londoner, warm and a little gravelly
voices.description: An older British man in his seventies with a warm, slightly gravelly London voice. He reads slowly and calmly, like a storyteller by the fire, with a wry, knowing warmth.

voices.name: Documentary narrator
voices.description: A British man in his fifties with a deep, rich voice and received pronunciation, like a nature documentary narrator. Precise and quietly captivating, reading at a natural, steady pace, never slow.

voices.name: American baritone
voices.description: A warm American man in his fifties with a rich baritone voice, relaxed and friendly, like a seasoned audiobook narrator. Natural, steady pacing with gentle emphasis, not slow.

voices.name: Late-night radio
voices.description: A calm, soft-spoken British woman in her forties with a clear, intimate voice, like a late-night radio host. Warm and close to the microphone, speaking at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: Scottish grandfather
voices.description: An old Scottish man with a gentle, slightly gravelly voice and a soft Highland accent. Kind and quietly humorous, like a grandfather telling a story, at a natural conversational pace, not slow.

voices.name: Podcast host
voices.description: A young American woman in her twenties with a bright, clear, friendly voice, like a thoughtful podcast host. Lively and smiling as she speaks, at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: Bedtime voice
voices.description: A man in his forties with a very deep, velvety voice. Relaxed and soothing, like reading a bedtime story, but at a natural, steady pace rather than a slow one.

voices.name: Irish storyteller
voices.description: An Irish man in his sixties with a warm, musical voice and a lilting accent. Playful and expressive, like a pub storyteller who loves a good tale, speaking at a lively, natural pace.

voices.name: Newsreader
voices.description: A British woman in her thirties with crisp received pronunciation, like a radio newsreader. Clear, composed and authoritative, reading at a brisk, steady pace.

voices.name: London friend
voices.description: A young woman from London in her twenties with a friendly, lively voice and a light London accent. Natural and upbeat, like telling a friend something interesting, at an easy, quick pace.

voices.name: Edinburgh reader
voices.description: A Scottish woman from Edinburgh in her forties with a calm, clear voice and a soft Scottish accent. Thoughtful and warm, reading at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: Dublin voice
voices.description: An Irish woman from Dublin in her thirties with a warm, bright voice and a gentle Irish accent. Friendly and expressive, speaking at a natural, lively pace.

voices.name: Welsh narrator
voices.description: A Welsh man in his forties with a warm, melodic voice and a gentle Welsh lilt. Clear and kind, like a narrator reading a favourite book aloud, at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: News anchor
voices.description: An American woman in her forties with a crisp, confident voice and a neutral General American accent, like an evening news anchor. Clear and polished, at a brisk, steady pace.

voices.name: Southern gentleman
voices.description: An American man in his sixties from the South with a warm, easygoing voice and a soft Southern accent. Friendly and good-humoured, at a natural conversational pace, not slow.

voices.name: New York reporter
voices.description: A man in his thirties from New York with a quick, energetic, mid-range male voice and a light New York accent, like a radio reporter. Sharp, clear and engaging, at a brisk, steady pace.

voices.name: Midwest grandmother
voices.description: An American woman in her seventies from the Midwest with a kind, gentle voice. Warm and reassuring, like a grandmother reading to her grandchildren, at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: West Coast guide
voices.description: A young man in his twenties from California with a relaxed, friendly voice. Easygoing but clear, like explaining something he finds fascinating, at a natural, lively pace.

voices.name: Canadian host
voices.description: A Canadian woman in her thirties with a friendly, clear voice and a light Canadian accent, like a public radio host. Warm and curious, at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: Canadian teacher
voices.description: A Canadian man in his forties with a calm, patient voice, like a favourite teacher explaining something clearly. Warm and even, at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: Sydney narrator
voices.description: An Australian woman in her thirties from Sydney with a warm, open voice and a clear Australian accent. Friendly and grounded, reading at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: Outback yarn
voices.description: An Australian man in his forties with a lively, dry-humoured voice and a broad Australian accent, like someone telling a good yarn. Relaxed but energetic, at a natural pace.

voices.name: Wellington reader
voices.description: A woman from New Zealand in her forties with a calm, clear voice and a gentle New Zealand accent. Thoughtful and kind, reading at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: Cape Town narrator
voices.description: A South African man in his fifties with a rich, warm voice and a South African English accent. Confident and engaging, like a documentary narrator, at a natural, steady pace.

voices.name: Mumbai lecturer
voices.description: An Indian woman in her thirties with a crisp, articulate voice and an Indian English accent, like a university lecturer. Clear and warm, at a brisk, steady pace.

voices.name: Delhi professor
voices.description: An Indian man in his fifties with a warm, measured voice and an Indian English accent, like a kind professor. Thoughtful and clear, at a natural, steady pace, not slow.

voices.name: Conteur parisien
voices.description: Un homme parisien d'une cinquantaine d'années, voix grave et posée, comme un narrateur de documentaire. Chaleureux et précis, à un rythme naturel et régulier, jamais lent.

voices.name: Conteuse douce
voices.description: Une femme d'une quarantaine d'années à la voix douce, claire et chaleureuse, comme une conteuse qui lit une histoire le soir, à un rythme naturel et régulier.

voices.name: Vieux conteur
voices.summary: Older, warm and a little husky
voices.description: Un homme âgé à la voix grave, chaleureuse et un peu rauque. Il lit calmement, comme un conteur au coin du feu, à un rythme naturel, pas lent.

voices.name: Journaliste
voices.description: Une femme parisienne d'une trentaine d'années à la voix nette et assurée, comme une présentatrice de journal à la radio. Claire et posée, à un rythme vif et régulier.

voices.name: Québécois
voices.description: Un homme québécois d'une quarantaine d'années avec l'accent du Québec, une voix chaleureuse et amicale. Naturel et souriant, à un rythme naturel et vivant.

voices.name: Québécoise
voices.description: Une jeune femme québécoise d'une trentaine d'années avec l'accent du Québec, une voix claire et pétillante. Enjouée et chaleureuse, à un rythme naturel et vivant.

voices.name: Bruxelloise
voices.description: Une femme belge de Bruxelles d'une cinquantaine d'années avec un léger accent belge, une voix calme et bienveillante. Posée et claire, à un rythme naturel et régulier.

voices.name: Marseillais
voices.description: Un homme de Marseille d'une soixantaine d'années avec l'accent chantant du Midi, une voix chaleureuse et pleine d'humour. Vivant et expressif, comme un conteur sur une place de village, à un rythme naturel.
